verdict.rationale: Smooth lets a developer drive a persistent browser session with natural-language sub-tasks. Sessions expose `run_task`, `goto`, `extract` and `evaluate_js` actions, and the docs suggest breaking workflows into smaller steps. This approximates an `act` primitive on described elements, and the docs stress describing what you want rather than writing selectors. There are no granular click/type primitives on described elements, and nothing documents resilience to selector or layout changes. missing for 10: dedicated act/click/type primitives targeting described elements, documented robustness to selector/layout changes, independent hands-on corroboration.
